title.mr: आंतरराष्ट्रीय विद्यार्थी केंद्र व जागतिक दालन

subtitle.en: Hosting scholars under the 15% MEA & MHRD quota in collaboration with ICAR, ICCR & Embassies — complete with AC hostel rooms, Advisor's Desk & Campus Map.
subtitle.mr: ICAR व ICCR भागीदारीतून १५% विशेष कोट्यांतर्गत प्रवेश, २१ वसतिगृह सुविधा, विदेशी विद्यार्थी सल्लागार कक्ष व राहुरी कॅम्पस नकाशा.

paragraphs.en: The Mahatma Phule Agricultural University, Rahuri attracts the largest number of foreign students in comparison to all other Indian Agricultural Universities. Apart from offering a multi-cultural and inter disciplinary learning environment one of the main reasons for studying at Mahatma Phule Agricultural University, Rahuri is the manageable cost of living and the conducive environment for education in Agricultural field. Currently we have around 8 students from over 6 countries studying at the Mahatma Phule Agricultural University, Rahuri and its affiliated colleges.
paragraphs.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ, राहुरी येथे परदेशी विद्यार्थ्यांची संख्या सर्व भारतीय कृषी विद्यापीठांमध्ये सर्वाधिक आहे. सध्या ६ हून अधिक देशांमधील विद्यार्थी राहुरी व संलग्न महाविद्यालयांत शिक्षण घेत आहेत.

paragraphs.en: The International Students Center of the Mahatma Phule Agricultural University, Rahuri located on campus and assists the International Students Community in acquiring information about the various courses, colleges, tuition structures, eligibility, accommodation, health insurance, FRO registration and the likes offered by the University. It is also operative in arranging for the students admissions and their overall welfare.
paragraphs.mr: राहुरी मुख्य संकुलातील आंतरराष्ट्रीय विद्यार्थी केंद्र अभ्यासक्रम, शुल्क, निवास, आरोग्य विमा व FRO नोंदणीसाठी मार्गदर्शन करते.

paragraphs.en: The International Center administers the special 15% over and above quota of International Students created jointly by the Ministry of External Affairs and Ministry of Human Resources and Development (MEA & MHRD) Government of India. The office of the Registrar, MPKV, Rahuri is the nodal agency that coordinates all the activities related to the admission of International Students through a unique single-window system (registrar.mpkv@nic.in). The International Center coordinates with the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) and Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), Ministry of External Affairs and Ministry of Human Resources and Development (MEA and MHRD) and with different Embassies and Consulates for various purposes including getting Scholarships as well as administering any agreement with International Partners of higher education.
paragraphs.mr: केंद्र शासनाच्या MEA व MHRD अंतर्गत अतिरिक्त १५% परदेशी विद्यार्थी कोट्याचे व्यवस्थापन केले जाते. कुलसचिव कार्यालय (registrar.mpkv@nic.in) ICAR, ICCR व दूतावासांशी समन्वय साधते.

paragraphs.en: The International Center acts as a liaison between the students, the various Departmental Heads and the Heads of Colleges and Institutions affiliated under the Mahatma Phule Agricultural University, Rahuri as well as the Heads of Chancery, Embassies, Consulates, their educational counsellors and their educational wings, throughout the world or with any other agencies of the Government of India or the Government of other Countries. For more detail information you can contact on following University website (www.mpkv.ac.in) or contact on Foreign Students Advisors.
paragraphs.mr: हे केंद्र विद्यार्थी, महाविद्यालय प्रमुख आणि संबंधित देशांच्या दूतावासांमधील दुवा म्हणून कार्य करते.

facilities.en: Well-furnished with Air Conditioner and self-content hostel room (one bed room, one kitchen and WC) for each student.
facilities.mr: प्रत्येक विद्यार्थ्यासाठी वातानुकूलित (AC), स्वयंपाकघर व स्वच्छतागृह असलेली स्वतंत्र खोली.

facilities.en: Well-equipped bed.
TV with cable facility
Internet connection (24 x 7 hr.) / Wi-Fi connection.
All required utensils for cooking (cupboard for keeping food material).
facilities.mr: स्वयंपाकाची सर्व आवश्यक भांडी व धान्य कपाट.

facilities.en: One refrigerator
Gas stove with gas cylinder
Newspapers and Magazines etc.
Separate reading/study place
Bicycle facility to travel in the field
facilities.mr: शेती व परिसरात प्रवासासाठी सायकल सुविधा.

facilities.en: Vehicle facility to travel to FRO office/educational tour etc.
facilities.mr: FRO कार्यालय व शैक्षणिक सहलीसाठी वाहन व्यवस्था.

facilities.en: Medical dispensary
Well fenced compound to International Students Hostel for security purpose.
Security person to International Students Hostel (24x7 hr.).
Well maintained lawn/garden in front of the International Students Hostel
Water and light facility (24 x 7 hr.)
Hot water supply during winter season. Water cooler is provided for drinking water.
facilities.mr: हिवाळ्यात गरम पाणी व पिण्यासाठी वॉटर कुलर.

facilities.en: Bank, grocery shops, post office, medical dispensary are very close to the International Students Hostel.
facilities.mr: बँक, किराणा, टपाल व दवाखाना अगदी जवळ.

facilities.en: Library facility in the department as well as at University Library.
Very close supervision of Foreign Students Advisor on the International Students.
Foreign Students Advisors regular vigilance.

paragraphs.en: Mahatma Phule Agricultural University as an educational hub hosts students from across the globe. The Mahatma Phule Agricultural University can boast of having the largest number of International Students in comparison to all other Indian Agricultural Universities. The University offers high quality education at affordable costs.
paragraphs.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ हे जागतिक विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी परवडणाऱ्या शुल्कात उच्च दर्जाचे कृषी शिक्षण देणारे प्रमुख केंद्र आहे.

paragraphs.en: High technological education which indicates global awareness is the need of the hour. Globalization demands an education system which sensitizes individuals to global issues and enables them to think beyond borders. By offering an environment conducive to such learning the Mahatma Phule Agricultural University has emerged as a favoured high quality educational destination and facilities for International Students.
paragraphs.mr: जागतिक आव्हानांसाठी तंत्रज्ञानाधारित कृषी शिक्षणाचे अनुकूल वातावरण येथे उपलब्ध आहे.

paragraphs.en: The International Students Center facilitates easy acquisition of information about the various courses available at colleges, departments and institutes affiliated to MPKV Rahuri. It also provides students with health insurance and University medical facilities at the campus. Foreign students from all over the world are welcome here at Mahatma Phule Agricultural University, Rahuri.
paragraphs.mr: आरोग्य विमा, वैद्यकीय सुविधा व ICAR/ICCR समन्वयासह जगातील सर्व परदेशी विद्यार्थ्यांचे राहुरी येथे स्वागत आहे.
